items.title: Rob Mounsey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 9, 2025
items.q: The last time I saw Quincy Jones he actually sort of asked me this, he said, “How do you think young people get started today in this business?”

ctx.x: That’s so difficult. That is so difficult because it really has changed a lot. You know younger people ask about this, like what of my own experience can help them as young

people. [Sorry I’ve got the sun in my face.] And the business is so radically different now that I’m not sure that my — I always doubt that my own experiences are even appropriate anymore. The last time I saw Quincy Jones he actually sort of asked me this, he said, “How do you think young people get started today in this business?” And I had to say I have no idea. And he didn’t either. Because it’s radically different. Once a year I talk to students at NYU. We have an event every year about putting string…
